name: Salacia
summary: Salacia (Salacia reticulata) carries an editorial Grade B rating, but the studies recorded on this profile do not demonstrate that grade. Strongest recorded design is a narrative review, drawn from 3 recorded studies, none of which measured an outcome in people. Recorded activity centres on metabolic regulation, glucose metabolism support and glucose metabolism, which describes mechanism rather than demonstrated benefit. Noted cautions include antidiabetics.
